description: Election Commission - A member of the Anuradhapura Municipal Council and a member of the Embilipitiya Urban Council have Vacated their Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government councils (Anuradhapura Municipal Council and Embilipitiya Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and changes in elected positions at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
